text: Dispatch reserves and moves eligible finished goods through the defined allocation and confirmation states.
A completed Dispatch may only be corrected through the trusted Dispatch Reversal authority.
Internal Transfers move only positive, exact Raw Material or Finished Good batch balances between different active, storage-enabled Factory Locations.
Raw receiving validates supplier/reference, material, quantity, lot, and storage context before accepted stock becomes available.
Raw Material balances, batches, allocations, and deductions remain in each material's storage UOM.
Transfers, issues, returns, adjustments, and stock checks use controlled lifecycle paths.
Raw and finished-goods balances are server-derived from canonical posted evidence or established read models.
Factory Petty Cash records physical operational cash only.
Planning establishes intended production and may create or feed Job Orders through current controlled workflows.
Job Orders move through defined preparation, release, execution, completion, and exception states.
Execution pins the product recipe/BOM and SOP/version context needed to preserve historical meaning.
Published or execution-ready recipes and SOPs are versioned or pinned according to current contracts.
Every Production SOP version pins one explicit Product Recipe version.
Inventory owns an append-only publication chain per outlet and month.

The Audit Stock Check Result pins the canonical Master Inventory unit cost into each item evidence row at submission, only when a cost was explicitly configured and the item's count UOM matches the cost UOM.
Canonical accounting EBITDA excludes separately classified Labour and OPEX, with no double counting.
Stock changes occur through established lifecycle authorities that validate scope, quantities, state, and retry identity.
The canonical balance is server-derived from accepted evidence or the established read model; the browser must not manufacture final stock.
Stock Check Groups is an outlet-scoped configuration surface; due/completed state and last-check evidence belong to Stock Check execution.
Asset availability and physical condition are separate canonical projections.
Financial records begin as controlled manual or imported inputs and feed canonical period projections.
Period snapshot authorities freeze the business state required for reproducible reporting.
Employee identity, job position, role, Admin access, and Crew Access are distinct concepts.
People owns one append-only effective-dated Employment Assignment Timeline for Employment Type, Employment Status, Position, Legal Employer and Workplace.
Crew Access is a one-to-one extension of an eligible employee and remains separate from Admin access.
People owns employee warnings and disciplinary records.
People owns the user-facing Food Handling Compliance capability.
People owns Recruitment before employment.
Draft Duty Roster weeks are editable by authorized Admins and are not Crew-visible.
Publishing atomically creates an immutable Crew-facing revision for one outlet week.
Attendance is recorded through token-bound server authority.
Leave balances are server-derived from policy, entitlement, approved usage, pending reservations, adjustments, carry-forward, and expiry evidence.
Leave Policy owns effective-dated eligible Employment Types, annual allowance or unlimited method, and an explicit calendar-day or no-proration rule.
Admin task and cash actions require the relevant Crew Operations permission plus outlet scope.
Published task/content versions, completion evidence, cash calculations, float adjustments, handover confirmations, and ledger entries retain immutable or append-only history.
Published versions are immutable; edits create a new draft/version rather than rewriting Crew history.
Assignments pin the learning and SOP versions needed for reproducible progression.
Learning completion may produce evidence used for skills or certification, but the operational status or reward consequence belongs to Crew Performance and Reward.
Monthly Performance uses defined, private evidence adapters rather than reading mutable page state.
Finalized scores, approved reward outcomes, and payout evidence are immutable or superseded through explicit correction authority.
Customer Feedback preserves each guest submission as independent evidence.
Team Review is an independent monthly coworker-evidence domain under the Performance workspace.
An active Job Position explicitly opts into Team Review.
The Team Review result is the direct average of the four dimension averages, rounded to two decimals on a five-point scale.
Platform owns the Brand Master and explicit Brand–Outlet mappings; Restaurant retains the Outlet Master.
A creative concept has one immutable revision payload containing title, canonical outlet targets and one Facebook and/or one Instagram variant.
Lifecycle: Draft → Review → Approved → Scheduled → Published, with Rejected, Failed and Cancelled outcomes.
Brand Knowledge owns positioning, identity/story, audience, voice and communication guidelines.
MeSTI Cleaning of Area Requirements bind tasks directly to one or more canonical Factory Locations.

MeSTI Cleaning of Equipment has two canonical sources: scheduled Requirements bind tasks to active Equipment on a daily or selected-weekday recurrence, while After Production occurrences are created only when a completed Production uses a canonical Equipment binding from its pinned Production SOP.
MeSTI Calibration Requirements bind one active Factory Equipment instance and Calibration Type to one logical, forward-effective version lineage.
MeSTI Health Declaration is one unified Factory compliance evidence domain for Employee and Visitor submissions.
MeSTI Operator Hygiene Inspection records one daily inspection session keyed by inspection date.
MeSTI Waste Disposal uses versioned Location requirements with a positive required count for each scheduled day.
Label Management → Printers displays the reported connection and availability.
Production SOPs bind the canonical active Factory Equipment instances required by the controlled process.
Templates are English Full-Time or Part-Time contract templates.
The Employment Timeline may present Payroll pay revisions and Employment Documents as context, but those remain separate write authorities.

section: WhatsApp template catalog and staff suggestions
text: AI Flows offers an authorized read-only catalog reference for WhatsApp flows.
The WhatsApp Chat customer service window is projected only from signed, current-generation customer inbound evidence.

section: WhatsApp template catalog and staff suggestions
text: Chat and Campaign Message use the same WABA catalog with their existing send eligibility and template fingerprint checks.
Only the authenticated Product Feedback admin read authority may return contact evidence.
The Assistant uses the same owner-scoped source-status RPC as Data Sources.

section: Reel covers and provider live availability
text: Calendar, List, Detail and Social Analytics show the same availability while retaining historical publication and metric semantics.
Factory Master Data supplies materials, products, storage-enabled Factory Locations, supplier, customer, recipe, and unit references.
Unified Inbox defaults to real social conversations; internal cases have an explicit separate channel view.

Marketing owns append-only WhatsApp consent evidence (exact brand/customer/current phone, decision, source/reference, occurred/recorded time and optional expiry), suppression, language/tag/outlet segments, registered sender declarations, immutable campaign revisions, approvals, recipient queues and staff action events.
Alerts may identify risk but do not become an alternative source for underlying values.
Factory MeSTI Finished Product Storage Control is a read-only report over canonical completed Production rows and their `factory_finished_good_batch_balances` entries.
Completed production QC and finished-product storage entries are available with scoped counts and filters.

section: Phase 5 V1 — Draft and Private Final Payslips
text: Payroll owns payslips separately from Legal Contracts and Employment Documents.
Duty Roster remains scheduled work, Attendance remains actual evidence, and neither becomes payable time until Payroll explicitly approves a result.
Current employee, role, permission, Auth-link, role-configuration, RLS, and audit contracts are authoritative.
Released/completed orders, pinned master-data versions, material consumption, outputs, exceptions, and batch lineage retain auditable evidence.
